login.title: Workcenter
login.guest-intro-1: This instance has guest access enabled.
login.guest-intro-2: Guests have view-only access to dashboards, so cannot write any changes to disk.
login.error-no-user-configured: Authentication is not enabled, or no users have been configured

remote-config.title: Load Remote Config?
remote-config.intro: You are loading a configuration from an external URL. Would you like to continue?
remote-config.warning: You should ensure that you've read the content you are loading before proceeding. Once loaded, your browser will be able to execute any client-side code specified within this config.
remote-config.preview-note: Preview only. This won't make any changes on disk, nor affect your Workcenter instance in any way.
remote-config.error-invalid-url: Remote config URL is not valid (must be http or https)
remote-config.error-fetch: Could not fetch remote config. Check the URL is reachable and CORS is allowed.
remote-config.error-parse: Remote config is not valid YAML
remote-config.error-not-config: Remote file does not look like a Workcenter config

updates.sw-update-available: A new version of Workcenter is available.

critical-error.title: Configuration Load Error
critical-error.subtitle: Workcenter has failed to load correctly due to a configuration error.

switcher.label: Applications
switcher.unavailable: {app} is not configured. Set its address in appConfig.applications.
switcher.shortcut-hint: Alt+1 Files, Alt+2 Chat, Alt+3 Mail

pane.loading-hint: This is taking longer than usual. The application may be starting up.

unavailable.title: {app} is not responding
unavailable.message: The application could not be loaded, or its address is not configured.
unavailable.check-failed: The health check for this application is failing.

blocked.title: {app} cannot be shown here
blocked.message: The application refuses to be embedded. It must allow Workcenter as a frame ancestor.

auth-error.title: Your session for {app} has expired
auth-error.message: Sign in again, or open the application in a new tab.

timeout.title: {app} did not finish loading
timeout.message: The application did not respond in time. It may still be starting up.

files.unconfigured: The Files pane has no address configured. Set appConfig.applications.files.url.
files.footnote: Rows open FileBrowser at that view. Browsing inside the pane arrives with the file broker.

chat.unconfigured: The Chat pane has no address configured. Set appConfig.applications.chat.url.
chat.footnote: Your channels and direct messages are read from Zulip once the broker carries the chat adapter.

mail.unconfigured: The Mail pane has no address configured. Set appConfig.applications.mail.url.
mail.footnote: Rows open SOGo at that view. Folder counts are read from the mailbox once the broker carries the mail adapter.

files.description: Browse, search and edit your files

chat.description: Team chat, organised by channel and topic
